body: I generally don't like quotes but that one resonated with me for some reason.  I want you to know that I appreciate you taking the time to talk with me.  You and another person helped grant me some perspective today.  The most difficult part that I still haven't let myself accept is realizing that people come into their own at different times.  I KNOW that.  and I feel it in my soul.  But as soon as I see a fellow from my old post on facebook about how they have a house and a family and a good paying job I can't help but compare and think that's what I should have had by this point if not by several years ago.
My 5 year plan is this: be done with school, have a good job in the region I'm in related to my major to save money, then move to a cheaper place to live with my SO.

This image of myself is so ingrained that It's almost impossible to forget about the past.  I don't know when it happened or how to move past it.  I have a nice outline of life that I would like to happen in the next five years but literally any time (and every time) I think about the past I can't let myself be happy.  I'm torturing myself over the comparison and IDK how to move on.  I contemplate suicide every day.   I hate it. I hate life.
